Lessons: What Is Apologetics?; Evidence for God's Existence; Can We Trust the Bible?; The Resurrection: History and Hope; Why Does God Allow Suffering?; Answering Objections with Grace
Description: Have you ever frozen when someone challenged your faith? This course equips you to respond thoughtfully and kindly, with reasons grounded in Scripture, history and logic. You will learn to listen well, answer honestly, and let gentleness lead every conversation.
